newsitem.title: RWANDA: Aid workers say Zaire closes Rwandan border point.
newsitem.headline: Aid workers say Zaire closes Rwandan border point.

text.p: Aid workers said Zaire closed a main border crossing with Rwanda on Thursday after accusing Rwandan troops of fighting alongside ethnic Tutsi rebels in eastern Zaire.
"We were told by the Zairean security the border with Rwanda at Gisenyi has been closed as of this morning," said an aid worker who was at a security meeting in the eastern Zairean town of Goma.

Rwanda denies Zairean accusations its troops invaded eastern Zaire and are fighting alongside Banyamulenge ethnic Tutsi rebels who are advancing in South Kivu province bordering on Rwanda and Burundi.
